name: Colombo
notes: Colombo District: Central Bank of Sri Lanka Land Valuation Indicator for residential land (per-perch bare land valuations of the Government Valuation Department), half-yearly from 2009 H1, each half placed at its last quarter. The 1998-based series (5 divisional secretariat divisions) is joined to the 2017 H1 = 100 series (all 13 divisions) at 2017 H1; the two disagree over 2017 H2 (+4.9% against +6.8%). This is a LAND valuation series, not a dwelling price index. Dwelling series from CBSL (new condominium price index from 2020 Q1, asking-price indices from 2019, read from the charts of the quarterly Real Estate Market Analysis) are shown as segments; they are too short for the valuation. Sri Lanka has no national index: Colombo District stands in for the country.
